name: Flat scallop / Three inks
look: Flat print in white, scarlet and soot with one lagoon cyan: heavy even contours, offset scallop waves, fir rows; plate B is a wire schematic on scarlet

axes.line: one soot contour of constant width on every shape; no pressure, no taper
axes.tone: flat fills in three inks; no tone, no hatching, no gradient
axes.planB: schematic: the same frame in sheet wire on scarlet, soot guides and dimensions
axes.motion: on threes (8 drawings a second) with a small shake per drawing
axes.accent: lagoon cyan on one thing per shot
axes.font: stencil capitals once the engine has a stroke font; none until then
axes.match: silhouette: the accent shape keeps its outline and place across the cut
